O Jesus, through the Immaculate Heart of: O Yesu, okuyita mu Mutima Omutukuvu gwa Maria, nkutendereza n’okusaba kwange, emirimu gyange, essanyu lyange n’okubonaabona kwange olwaleero, ku lw’ebigendererwa by’Omutima Gwo Omutukuvu, nga nkolera wamu n’Ekirabo ekitukuvu ekya Misa mu nsi yonna, ng’ekyokuddamu eri ebibi, ku lw’ebigendererwa by’abagenyi bange bonna n’abalala, era naddala ku lw’ebigendererwa bya Kitaawe Omutukuvu.
O My God, I love you with my whole heart: O Katonda wange, nkukwatako n'omutima gwange gwonna era okusinga byonna kubanga oli mulungi nnyo era mutuufu; era njagala baliraanwa bange nga bwe njagala nze olw'okukwagala. Nkwegayirira onnyambe nkulekere okukwagala ennyo mu bulamu buno n'obulamu obuliddako emirembe gyonna.
O My God, I thank you for all the benefi: O Katonda wange, nkwebaza olw'emiganyulo gyonna gye nfuna okuva gyoli leero. Mpa ekitangaala okulaba ebibi bye nnakola, era onnyambe nsonyiwe ddala mu mazima.
O most gracious Virgin of Guadalupe, in: Omutukuvu Omubereberye ow'e Guadalupe, mu kulabikako kwo ku Lusozi Tepeyac, wasuubiza okulaga obusaasizi n'obulungi eri abo bonna abakwagala era abakwesiga, nga banoonya obuyambi n'obukuumi bwo.

Omutukuvu Virgin wa Guadalupe, mu kulabikako kwo ku lusozi Tepeyac, wateekawo okutegeeza nti ojja kuba n’obusaasizi n’obulungi eri abo bonna abakwagala era abakwesiga nga banoonya obuyambi n’okukuuma kwo. Wuliriza okusaba kwaffe era otuwe obuwanguzi n’okusanyuka. Tulina essuubi nti, nga twesigamye ku buyambi bwo, tewali kintu kyonna kisobola kututabangula oba okutukosa. Nga bw’osigadde naffe mu kifaananyi kyo ekirungi, ka tufune obulungi bwe twetaaga. Amiina.
O my God, because you are so good, I am: O Katonda wange, kubanga oli mulungi nnyo, nsaba nnyo nti nnayonoona gy’oli. N’obuyambi bw’ekisa kyo, ndigenda okugezaako obutaddamu kukola bubi.
O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us: O Yesu wange, tusonyiwe ebibi byaffe, otuwonye okuva mu muliro gw'omuliro ogw'omu hell, omutwale emyoyo gyonna mu ggulu, naddala abo abali mu bwetaavu obusinga obungi obw'obusaasizi bwo. Amiina.
Of you I ask for the sake of the blood t: Nkubuuza ku lw'omusaayi Yesu gwe yayiwa, okusaba kwange kuddibwemu.
Oh my 13 Blessed souls so wise and under: Oo, emyoyo gyange 13 egy'omukisa era egy'amagezi n'okutegeera, mbasaba okwagala kwa Katonda okusaba kwange kuddibweemu.
